subject: Raw accelerometer data from wearable device

messages.author: 786d23a23fdbfd7f
messages.subject: Raw accelerometer data from wearable device
parts:
Good afternoon all,

First of all, thank you very much for such outstanding work on GGIR package.

I am planning to conduct a study on which I will be recording accelerometer data using a wearable device (my smartphone) in free-living activities. I already receive the raw accelerometer data from app server in a .csv file (values from all three axis, expressed in g, mg, and m/s`2). Nevertheless, I am not sure about how to analyse this kind of data by GGIR package. Should I convert the .csv file to .bin or it's possible to analyse the raw data in GGIR directly in .csv format?

Best

Natan Feter
Brazil.

messages.author: 8d92e34685fbc6bd
messages.subject: Re: [GGIR] Raw accelerometer data from wearable device
parts:
Hi Natan,
Best approach is probably to convert your data to match the format of the Actigraph csv file, see my response to previous discussion on 28 June 2016:
https://groups.google.com/forum/#!searchin/rpackageggir/karteek%7Csort:relevance/rpackageggir/RIQyCi9ZmhA/k67trD4hAgAJ
Cheers, Vincent
